content.text:
The robot followed the corridor to the green panel and called `rest` with it in front. The robot is crouched and motors are off.

The route was: about 3 m straight, a left turn at the wall, then about 3 m forward toward the panel. The last few steps were stopped by the collision-protection safety zone, so I couldn't measure the exact distance. From the bottom camera the panel sits right at the robot's feet, so I judge it to be roughly 0.1 to 0.3 m away. I also sidestepped about 0.3 m left to get around something close on the right. The robot finished slightly rotated, at about 1.41 rad heading. Battery is at 99%.
